overview: This Senate resolution names June 15, 2026, as "World Elder Abuse Awareness Day" and June 2026 as "Elder Abuse Awareness Month." It describes the many forms of elder abuse, including physical and emotional abuse, neglect and financial scams, and notes that most cases go unreported. It recognizes the work of adult protective services, long-term care ombudsman programs that look out for nursing home residents, law enforcement and others. It encourages the public and professionals to learn the warning signs and report abuse, and urges federal agencies to fully carry out their duties to protect older adults. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on July 21, 2026, after the dates it names had passed.
for: Supporters say raising awareness helps families, caregivers and professionals spot and report abuse and scams aimed at older Americans.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not add funding or new protections for older adults.
